decisions.reason: The source changes who is represented by eligible tickets, not the Small Block prize amount, draw interval, ticket window, reset rule, or funding semantics.
The source changes winner eligibility through ticket ownership but leaves the Big Block prize parameters, draw interval, ticket window, reset rule, and funding semantics unchanged.

The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already records the increased opportunities from holding more tickets and the transfer of active tickets to a resale buyer; no additional FAQ update or removal is required.
Eligibility following ticket ownership or resale does not change when tickets are issued, their initial recipient, their quantity, or their draw cycles.
The source retains random allocation to an existing NFT holder when no referral is supplied and does not change this allocation mechanism.
Changing the eligible winner population does not alter the one-click manual claim action or its Winners-page location.
The ticket-holder winner-selection change does not alter the $5 referral commission trigger, recipient, timing, destination, or payout mode.
The separate Small and Big Block counters and their post-draw reset behavior remain valid; the source changes eligibility based on ownership rather than counter accounting.
The source does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
Ticket ownership and winner eligibility do not change the enabled flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active prize tickets transfer to the resale buyer, which fully captures the resale-state effect underlying the winner-eligibility change.
The source changes who may be selected but leaves the Winners-page announcement channel unchanged.
